meta.name: terraform-skill
meta.description: Use when writing, reviewing, or debugging Terraform/OpenTofu modules, tests, CI, scans, or state ops - diagnoses failure mode (identity churn, secrets, blast radius, CI drift, state corruption) with version-aware guards.

copy.tagline: 编写、审查和调试 Terraform 模块与状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果日常维护 Terraform 配置并需要自动化检查与调试
copy.tagline_en: Write, review, and debug Terraform modules and state
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain Terraform configs and need automated checks and debugging

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会帮你诊断 Terraform/OpenTofu 配置中的问题，比如资源地址变动、密钥泄露、影响范围过大等，并给出修复建议和验证步骤。
howto.when: 当你编写、审查或调试 Terraform/OpenTofu 模块、测试、CI 流水线或状态操作时触发。

say.text: 帮我检查这个 Terraform 模块有没有密钥泄露风险。
say.note: Claude 会分析模块并给出安全建议。

say.text: 我重构了资源，如何避免地址变动导致资源重建？
写一个 Terraform 测试，验证子网 CIDR 是否正确。
say.note: Claude 会生成测试代码并说明适用场景。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps diagnose issues in Terraform/OpenTofu configurations, such as resource address churn, secret exposure, or blast radius, and provides fixes and validation steps.
howto.when_en: Triggered when writing, reviewing, or debugging Terraform/OpenTofu modules, tests, CI pipelines, or state operations.

say_en.text: Check this Terraform module for secret exposure risks.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze and give security advice.

say_en.text: How to avoid resource recreation after refactoring addresses?
say_en.note: Claude will guide on using moved blocks or for_each.

say_en.text: Write a Terraform test to verify subnet CIDR.
say_en.note: Claude will generate test code and explain usage.
